Problem

A RunStart publication can be durable before later runtime admission fails. Current RunStatus is only an in-memory projection, so its absence or a generic submission error cannot resolve the original publication fact.

## Change

Add the narrow schema-2 ObjectiveAdmission read method to the original Agentd owner. It matches the exact saved authentication, including the original signature, canonical body, run and profile, and optionally checks a previously retained sequence/chain anchor against the recovered journal prefix. Published metadata and finite unknown reasons preserve the distinction between publication, current runtime admission and effects.

The query uses the original owner mutex and recovered journal. It does not append, recover/truncate a file, advance replay state, start an old run, reconcile effects or grant authority. Expired/revoked historical requests can still match their old publication; fresh submissions retain the original current authorization checks. Current endpoint identity and the original request generation remain separate.

The original product change remains pinned to 2be5fc052ae7b2e9fb08c68a3ae7e5a218ad37d5. The later commit d32e795f0d24df89fc57745f6fae70fbd0642eba changes only two CI workflow lines and retains CI diagnosis/validation under qualification/ci; no original product or contract input changed. No Cargo manifest/lock or Bazel lock changes. The R8 source contract remains unchanged. Desktop consumer PR #193 and evidence PR #194 in TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop are now ordinarily merged.

## Executed product validation and exact source boundaries

- Protocol/ledger --lib suites: 134 passed / 1 existing ignored at ee0a2e5eee299fc0f272c3ceb09ef70f2cbfaf73.
- Agentd --lib suite: 173 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored at d1d40f64eadd0210f5f6abc003cd479a0e1ee010, including four new history tests. These are two differently pinned runs, not a final-head full-suite run. Their dev-dependency graph unified default/production-cognitive-write despite no-default command flags.
- Final scoped just fix and just fmt --base f8 completed. The final product change after d1 boxes Published metadata and reformats documentation without changing JSON wire; unrelated existing automatic fixes were reverted.
- Native05 build at the fixed 2be product head passed on x86_64 Linux with Rust 1.95.0, locked/offline dev-small, j1. Actual Agentd lib/bin rustc features=[]. Executed ELF SHA-256: a8f8aefa2199a2e41c22b8251145f064e3af767ff5357475ddb527beb86761cb.
- Actual original Fleet/Supervisor + three real desktop CLIs + newly built history probe passed 15 checks, 13 history queries, five distinct Objective requests, four durable publications, three controlled restarts and zero recovery resubmissions. Runtime report SHA-256: edbfff169707cd2946a549f9edeaf0548eefbb6765e757e7039dabf0fe430f4b. Two independent read-only reviews verified sources, five ELF identities, saved request/output bytes and journal prefixes.
- The real ARM64 history job 117655596136 in run 39115155092 also passed at owner 2be and desktop 46dcb2d691827f7aa3ad7903dae09d39fd338126, with 15 checks, 13 history queries and zero recovery resubmissions. The original artifact and all five actual AArch64 ELF bytes were recovered and independently rechecked on 2026-10-19. These are fixed-source qualifications, not newly executed product tests on the CI-only candidate.

## Required-CI timeout repair

Original run 39114831266 ended with scoped native job 117665655613 cancelled and CI required failing correctly with `CI dependencies did not succeed: hepta-scoped: cancelled`. The cancelled job's own log returned 404 BlobNotFound and no run artifacts were available; its last compiler/test phase is unknown.

The fixed workflow allocated 40 minutes for the entire job while the single executor allowed 60 minutes for dependency planning, compilation and all selected tests. The 45-minute observed lifetime is consistent with the outer limit plus GitHub's documented cancellation window; this is an inference, not a recovered cancellation message.

The repair sets the outer job budget to 75 minutes and explicitly retains `--timeout-seconds 3600`. Package selection, child arguments, `--locked`, `always()` artifact retention, scope policy and rejection of cancelled dependencies are unchanged. Workflow changes intentionally select `full_repo=true`; no scope exception was added. The new candidate requires its own normal full-repository CI. A full-repository run must not be described as a new scoped-lane execution.

Local CI-only verification: 71 existing Python tests passed, all nine inline Bash blocks parsed, PyYAML accepted only the two intended changes, and official actionlint 1.7.12 passed. Required formatting completed without relevant formatter groups. No Rust test was rerun after formatting. The original receipts and required-job log are retained unchanged in the [CI qualification note](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/d32e795f0d24df89fc57745f6fae70fbd0642eba/qualification/ci/scoped-native-timeout-2026-10-19.md).

## Scope and review boundaries

The actual fourth request returned submit_unknown / objective_owner_request_rejected while exact history found compiled publication #4 and RunStatus was null. Capacity exhaustion is a fixed-source/precondition inference; its specific original error bytes were not captured.

Lost reply is exercised by an original-protocol qualification harness, not by the hepta-submit CLI itself. Rollback and truncation are injected only after a confirmed controlled stop; this is not a mid-write crash or power-loss qualification. The caller-retained anchor and journal can still be jointly rolled back outside this profile.

No production issuer, model turn, Operations K/D, device effect, historical run resume, kernel G1/G2 or mobile qualification is claimed. Original failed build attempts and targeted cache-repair evidence are retained. The local native/runtime used an existing repaired cache, not a cold-build resource profile.

## Published evidence

[Complete source-bound report](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/blob/24b5c127a5c4bfb2747369526995c133de18543b/results/integration/2026-10-18-objective-history/README.md) contains original receipts, failures, independent reviews, the 11-module documentation audit and the exact reconstructible raw archive.

[Terminal desktop/ARM CI and restored-byte evidence](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/blob/7a786836357816990bd3633901f6951d107b7593/results/integration/2026-10-18-objective-history-ci/README.md) was ordinarily merged through desktop PR #194. Desktop code PR #193 merged as aab50f347deb53fc79ac13ea3b84f846fefc70a7; evidence PR #194 merged as 0c2bf0fc1ba473325a0266c7bd476b1ddbf66383. Source-head tests and merge-tree identity are recorded separately.

Problem

A RunStart publication can be durable before later runtime admission fails. Current RunStatus is only an in-memory projection, so its absence or a generic submission error cannot resolve the original publication fact.

## Change

Add the narrow schema-2 ObjectiveAdmission read method to the original Agentd owner. It matches the exact saved authentication, including the original signature, canonical body, run and profile, and optionally checks a previously retained sequence/chain anchor against the recovered journal prefix. Published metadata and finite unknown reasons preserve the distinction between publication, current runtime admission and effects.

The query uses the original owner mutex and recovered journal. It does not append, recover/truncate a file, advance replay state, start an old run, reconcile effects or grant authority. Expired/revoked historical requests can still match their old publication; fresh submissions retain the original current authorization checks. Current endpoint identity and the original request generation remain separate.

The original product change remains pinned to 2be5fc052ae7b2e9fb08c68a3ae7e5a218ad37d5. The later commit d32e795f0d24df89fc57745f6fae70fbd0642eba changes only two CI workflow lines and retains CI diagnosis/validation under qualification/ci; no original product or contract input changed. No Cargo manifest/lock or Bazel lock changes. The R8 source contract remains unchanged. Desktop consumer PR #193 and evidence PR #194 in TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop are now ordinarily merged.

## Executed product validation and exact source boundaries

- Protocol/ledger --lib suites: 134 passed / 1 existing ignored at ee0a2e5eee299fc0f272c3ceb09ef70f2cbfaf73.
- Agentd --lib suite: 173 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored at d1d40f64eadd0210f5f6abc003cd479a0e1ee010, including four new history tests. These are two differently pinned runs, not a final-head full-suite run. Their dev-dependency graph unified default/production-cognitive-write despite no-default command flags.
- Final scoped just fix and just fmt --base f8 completed. The final product change after d1 boxes Published metadata and reformats documentation without changing JSON wire; unrelated existing automatic fixes were reverted.
- Native05 build at the fixed 2be product head passed on x86_64 Linux with Rust 1.95.0, locked/offline dev-small, j1. Actual Agentd lib/bin rustc features=[]. Executed ELF SHA-256: a8f8aefa2199a2e41c22b8251145f064e3af767ff5357475ddb527beb86761cb.
- Actual original Fleet/Supervisor + three real desktop CLIs + newly built history probe passed 15 checks, 13 history queries, five distinct Objective requests, four durable publications, three controlled restarts and zero recovery resubmissions. Runtime report SHA-256: edbfff169707cd2946a549f9edeaf0548eefbb6765e757e7039dabf0fe430f4b. Two independent read-only reviews verified sources, five ELF identities, saved request/output bytes and journal prefixes.
- The real ARM64 history job 117655596136 in run 39115155092 also passed at owner 2be and desktop 46dcb2d691827f7aa3ad7903dae09d39fd338126, with 15 checks, 13 history queries and zero recovery resubmissions. The original artifact and all five actual AArch64 ELF bytes were recovered and independently rechecked on 2026-10-19. These are fixed-source qualifications, not newly executed product tests on the CI-only candidate.

## Required-CI timeout repair

Original run 39114831266 ended with scoped native job 117665655613 cancelled and CI required failing correctly with `CI dependencies did not succeed: hepta-scoped: cancelled`. The cancelled job's own log returned 404 BlobNotFound and no run artifacts were available; its last compiler/test phase is unknown.

The fixed workflow allocated 40 minutes for the entire job while the single executor allowed 60 minutes for dependency planning, compilation and all selected tests. The 45-minute observed lifetime is consistent with the outer limit plus GitHub's documented cancellation window; this is an inference, not a recovered cancellation message.

The repair sets the outer job budget to 75 minutes and explicitly retains `--timeout-seconds 3600`. Package selection, child arguments, `--locked`, `always()` artifact retention, scope policy and rejection of cancelled dependencies are unchanged. Workflow changes intentionally select `full_repo=true`; no scope exception was added. The new candidate requires its own normal full-repository CI. A full-repository run must not be described as a new scoped-lane execution.

Local CI-only verification: 71 existing Python tests passed, all nine inline Bash blocks parsed, PyYAML accepted only the two intended changes, and official actionlint 1.7.12 passed. Required formatting completed without relevant formatter groups. No Rust test was rerun after formatting. The original receipts and required-job log are retained unchanged in the [CI qualification note](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/blob/d32e795f0d24df89fc57745f6fae70fbd0642eba/qualification/ci/scoped-native-timeout-2026-10-19.md).

## Scope and review boundaries

The actual fourth request returned submit_unknown / objective_owner_request_rejected while exact history found compiled publication #4 and RunStatus was null. Capacity exhaustion is a fixed-source/precondition inference; its specific original error bytes were not captured.

Lost reply is exercised by an original-protocol qualification harness, not by the hepta-submit CLI itself. Rollback and truncation are injected only after a confirmed controlled stop; this is not a mid-write crash or power-loss qualification. The caller-retained anchor and journal can still be jointly rolled back outside this profile.

No production issuer, model turn, Operations K/D, device effect, historical run resume, kernel G1/G2 or mobile qualification is claimed. Original failed build attempts and targeted cache-repair evidence are retained. The local native/runtime used an existing repaired cache, not a cold-build resource profile.

[Complete source-bound report](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/blob/24b5c127a5c4bfb2747369526995c133de18543b/results/integration/2026-10-18-objective-history/README.md) contains original receipts, failures, independent reviews, the 11-module documentation audit and the exact reconstructible raw archive.

Desktop code PR #193 merged as aab50f347deb53fc79ac13ea3b84f846fefc70a7; evidence PR #194 merged as 0c2bf0fc1ba473325a0266c7bd476b1ddbf66383.
